visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An East Asian man with a large black afro hairstyle and tattoos on his arms stands in a bright gym setting. He wears a dark tank top and pulls up his black shorts to inspect his legs with a serious expression. The background features various weight racks and yellow weight plates under bright overhead studio lighting. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the afro-haired man's face as he sings with an exaggerated, emotional expression. His mouth is wide open, and his eyes are squeezed shut in a dramatic display of passion while he faces the camera directly. The lighting is soft, highlighting his facial features and the texture of his hair. (3) The camera cuts to a muscular man with blonde-tipped hair, acting as the trainer. He looks directly at the camera with a confused yet intense facial expression. He wears a grey t-shirt and a silver necklace. The gym environment behind him is slightly blurred, creating depth. (4) The two men walk side-by-side through the gym. The afro-haired man sticks his tongue out playfully while the trainer looks on with a stern expression. They pass by various gym machines and mirrors. The camera follows them at eye-level, capturing their interaction and body language. (5) The trainer assists the afro-haired man with a barbell squat. The afro-haired man looks upward with a look of intense physical strain and comical disbelief. The trainer stands behind him, guiding the bar. The metallic texture of the barbell and the industrial gym ceiling are visible. (6) The afro-haired man lies on the grey gym floor, appearing exhausted or in pain. The trainer kneels beside him, gripping his leg firmly. Both men have exaggerated expressions—the afro-haired man is grimacing in agony while the trainer seems to be laughing or shouting. (7) The trainer is seen dragging the afro-haired man by his arm across the gym floor. The afro-haired man's body is limp, and his face is turned away from the camera. Other gym-goers and equipment are visible in the background, out of focus. (8) In the final scene, the afro-haired man shows his thigh to the trainer. The trainer takes the man's wallet and some packaged goods, appearing to have taken his money for supplements. They stand near weight racks, concluding the comedic narrative with a high-angle shot.
